tools.name: search_ad_inventory
tools.description: Find local digital out-of-home screens and available CTV, video, audio and display products for an agency client. Uses the advertiser portal inventory and prices.

tools.name: preview_campaign_plan
tools.description: Preview native campaign pricing and audience estimates for selected screens and channels. This does not reserve inventory or charge the advertiser.

tools.name: save_campaign_draft
tools.description: Save or update an agency-owned campaign and selected inventory in the advertiser portal. The agency remains the owner and payer; clientName labels the client brief.

tools.name: attach_campaign_creative
tools.description: Copy a user-selected creative file into the native campaign asset and moderation flow. Attach artwork before booking. Existing live artwork changes follow the portal replacement workflow.

tools.name: prepare_campaign_booking
tools.description: Read the exact current campaign selections, total, currency and creative readiness for the buyer to review before payment.

tools.name: create_campaign_checkout
tools.description: Create a Stripe checkout for the exact campaign and total the buyer reviewed. Open the returned checkoutUrl to complete payment. The campaign is booked after the verified native Stripe payment webhook.

tools.name: get_campaign_status
tools.description: Read the campaign and booking progress from the same order records as the advertiser portal, including creative review, scheduled dates and live fulfillment.

tools.name: get_campaign_delivery
tools.description: Read measured campaign delivery and screen performance from the native campaign reporting services.

tools.name: rebook_campaign
tools.description: Copy a previous campaign into a new unpaid campaign for new dates, preserving native creative lineage and obtaining fresh prices. Rebooking requires a new review and payment.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "advertiser" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare_campaign_booking, get_campaign_status · Private data: attach_campaign_creative, get_campaign_status · Public sink: create_campaign_checkout.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_campaign_booking, get_campaign_status · Private data: attach_campaign_creative, get_campaign_status · Public sink: create_campaign_checkout

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
